issues.description: The type of Farm.animals is inconsistent across the artifacts: the UML in the problem statement declares animals as a List<Animal>, while the textual Part 3 explicitly requires a Set implemented with a HashSet. The provided solution implements animals as a List (ArrayList). This ambiguity (List vs Set) will confuse students about which collection type to use and whether uniqueness must be enforced via a Set. It can also lead to mismatches between student implementations and the reference solution/tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the collection type for Farm.animals consistent across all artifacts. Either: (A) Update the problem statement/UML to require a List (and remove the HashSet/Set requirement), or (B) change the reference solution to use a Set<Animal> (HashSet) and initialize it in the no-argument constructor, and update getters/setters accordingly so they expose a Set. Ensure the UML, textual instructions, template comments, and solution all match the same collection type.
